learning_objective: 🎯 Become a master creator by learning how to write friendly letters and build perfectly organized paragraphs!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A paragraph is a group of sentences all about ONE single topic! It has a starting sentence, a few detail sentences in the middle, and a strong wrapping-up sentence at the end.
Informal letters are sweet notes we send to friends and family. They have a fun and relaxed tone, just like talking to someone you love face-to-face!
Every friendly letter needs a structure! We start with our address and the date, say a warm 'Dear [Name]', write our main message, and end with 'With love'.

fun_activity.title: ✉️ Secret Mail Carrier
fun_activity.instructions: Write a short, friendly letter to someone living in your own house! Follow the correct format, put it in an envelope, and secretly slide it under their door.

quick_recap: ⭐ A paragraph focuses on explaining just one main idea.
⭐ Informal letters are sent to friends and family to share news and feelings.
⭐ Always remember to include the date and a sweet greeting in your letters!
